content: Winterhold Guard: Fuck this cold. You see that bandit camp near the coast? Bunch of Rieklings riding mammoth cocks like they own the place. Disgusting little shits. Winterhold Guard 2: Pfft, at least the Rieklings aren’t as bad as those Draugr fuckers down in the ruins. Bastards don’t even bother pulling their pants down before they skull-fuck their victims. Makes me wanna puke. Winterhold Guard: Yeah, well, at least the Draugr don’t whine like those damn Forsworn. Last raid, I caught one of their bitches begging for it after I gutted her friend. Pathetic. Winterhold Guard 2: Hah! Should’ve seen the last group of Imperials we took down near Dawnstar. Those prissy milk-drinkers screamed like virgins when we showed ‘em what real Nords do to prisoners. Bet they’re still limping.

Winterhold Guard: Heh, sounds like you had fun. But fuck it, I’m freezing my balls off out here. Should’ve stayed in the barracks with that new Redguard whore warming my bed. Winterhold Guard 2: Pah, you wish. That slag wouldn’t touch your shriveled cock even if you paid her in dragon bones. Stop dreaming and keep your eyes on the damn road.

(Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Serana, Daegon, Ranmir, Nelacar, Dagur) (The location is now Winterhold.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): chicken, Winterhold Guard, Lydia, chicken, chicken) (MJR: k101DaegonFollowerHelloLines; Daegon: Hello!)
Winterhold Guard: By Dibella, you three look like you've been through a storm and back.

Daegon: You have no idea. I swear this frozen wasteland wants to kill me slowly while I'm still alive to feel it. Serana: My favorite part is watching Daegon shiver her pointy ears right off. Definitely worth the hike. Winterhold Guard: You're heading toward the College, I take it? Or just passing through to the inn for some warm mead and furs?
Winterhold Guard: That aurora looks like Dibella herself is dancing tonight.

Daegon: Redwater? You mean that dreary lookout where we first landed in this frozen hellscape? I remember the wolves and that blasted sabre cat. Serana: Redwater had better atmosphere than this town. At least there the snow was fresh. Here it smells like wet chicken and stale mead. Winterhold Guard: Redwater Lookout? That's a few days south. Rough country, but the hunting's good if you can handle the cold. You folks planning to head back that way?

Winterhold Guard: Still, if you're staying in Winterhold, best visit the inn. The mead's weak but the company's warm, if you catch my meaning. Dibella teaches us to share our warmth with travelers. Daegon: I'd rather share a bottle of Cyrodiilic brandy alone in a corner. But I suppose your Nords have their own ideas about hospitality.

Daegon: Oh, this is rich. The College gatekeeper putting on her little show. I remember when I had to prove myself at the Arcane University. At least they didn't make me freeze my ass off in the snow first. Serana: She's enjoying it too much. Look at that smug posture. I'd wager she hasn't cast a real combat spell in decades. Winterhold Guard: Faralda's been standing that post for years. Tougher than she looks, that one. Though I've never seen her let anyone in without some kind of parlor trick first.

Winterhold Guard: Well, I've seen Faralda turn away plenty of mages, but that's a first. Dibella's blessings, I suppose. Daegon: Of course. The College of Winterhold's grand tradition of magical admission reduced to a roadside dalliance. At least the view was better than that dusty old university. Serana: I'd say she passed the test with flying colors. Or should I say, with flying robes. Winterhold Guard: You College types certainly have interesting customs. We keep things simpler in the guard - a warm fire, good mead, and willing company when the night gets long.
